sql: WITH cte_pagamentos AS (SELECT num_doc_credor, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pagamentos FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND num_doc_credor NOT IN ('-1', '0') GROUP BY num_doc_credor), cte_transferencias AS (SELECT "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO", SUM(CAST("VALOR TRANSFERIDO" AS DECIMAL)) AS total_transferencias FROM cgu_transferencias WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 GROUP BY "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO") SELECT p.num_doc_credor, p.total_pagamentos, t.total_transferencias FROM cte_pagamentos p JOIN cte_transferencias t ON CAST(p.num_doc_credor AS VARCHAR) = CAST(t."CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO" AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY p.total_pagamentos DESC LIMIT 5;
